buff_kitty85: On Day 5 Hugo Kitty took a post at S-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He can fall asleep anywhere, instantly, and the men liked him for it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Hugo Kitty tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F22 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
warhamster4: The draft reached S-F18 on Day 3. Albin Warhamster was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A clear shot from S-F18. Albin Warhamster grazed Emil Ghostbebrii and slid back down below the parapet. Now serving as a sniper, Albin Warhamster discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Albin Warhamster went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F18 is closed now. Albin Warhamster fired at a movement across the wire at S-F18. The man went down: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla, badly wounded. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.
